# `foxglove device-tokens edit`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](device-tokens.md)

```text
Enable or disable a device token

Usage: foxglove device-tokens edit [OPTIONS] --enabled[=<ENABLED>] <DEVICE_TOKEN_ID>

Arguments:
  <DEVICE_TOKEN_ID>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --enabled[=<ENABLED>]
          Enable the token, or disable it with --enabled=false

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
